_meta.description: Normalized seller-payout country capability dataset. The frontend and coverage script read THIS, never hardcoded country arrays. A row counts toward ACTIVE coverage ONLY when availability_status=active AND implementation_status=implemented AND provider_approval_required is satisfied (approved=true) AND not sanctioned.
_meta.honesty_note: The platform HAS an approved Stripe Connect account (owner-confirmed 2026-08-05), but the code still runs Stripe in TEST MODE and no country has been live end-to-end payout-verified yet. Therefore NO country is 'active' yet: Stripe Connect countries are 'implemented' and 'pending_provider_approval'. A row flips to approved=true + availability_status=active ONLY after a real end-to-end payout is verified for that country (see docs/PAYMENTS_AND_PAYOUTS_ROADMAP.md, Step 1). Do NOT advertise a country as supported before that.

sources.stripe_connect: https://docs.stripe.com/connect/cross-border-payouts (checked 2026-08-05; documented, not confirmed for Petabyte's account)
